description: Witnesses (SPEC.md §31, Witnesses), for the integration of vectors/app/app.json (its integration key, channel encryption key) and the sale of its declaration (`sale`), made with fixed random bytes (NIP-44 nonces, BIP-340 auxiliary data). `derived`: the seen secret and author, the seen address key; `addresses`: witness addresses of an address, a transaction and a sale (null: `none`); `orderTags`: order tags of an address and a sale (null: `none`); `addressTags`: the address tag of an address. `events`: records as relays send them, with what they open to (`value`), or null when they are not a witness of this integration. A witness without `expiresAt`, or without its address tag, is not one. A record is of a newer format ("newer") only once its event checks out (SPEC.md §12): one that a relay sends without the seen secret's signature is nothing. An event holding a lone surrogate does not check out (SPEC.md §11).
